mapper.sql: id, project_id, product_type, serial_number, supplier_id, create_user_id, supplier_type, notes
mapper.select:
SELECT product.*, product.id as productId, product.quantity- COALESCE(link.quantity,0) as canDivideQuantity, m.id as 'monomer.id', m.name as 'monomer.name', ar.id as 'area.id', ar.name as 'area.name' FROM
tech_artifact AS product
tech_enclosure as product
LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON product.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN plan_monomer m ON product.monomer_id = m.id AND m.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN plan_area ar ON product.area_id = ar.id AND ar.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) as quantity FROM project_labor_subsupplier_order_product_link WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND area_id = #{areaId} GROUP BY product_id ) as link on link.product_id = product.id WHERE product.bool_delete_enum = 0 and product.quantity > COALESCE(link.quantity,0) AND product.area_id = #{areaId}
and product.name LIKE concat('%',#{name},'%')
and product.serial_number like concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
select count(*) from project_labor_subsupplier_order where project_id = #{projectId}
